code: import axios from'axios';const API_BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://localhost:8000';const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE_URL});export const analyzeResume=async(file,jobDescription)=>{console.log('[DEBUG client.js] Preparing FormData for /api/analyze...');const formData=new FormData();formData.append('resume_file',file);formData.append('job_description',jobDescription);console.log("[DEBUG client.js] Executing POST request to ".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/api/analyze..."));const response=await api.post('/api/analyze',formData);console.log('[DEBUG client.js] Response received from server:',response.data);return response.data;};export const getHistory=async()=>{console.log("[DEBUG client.js] Fetching history from ".concat(API_BASE_URL,"/api/history..."));const response=await api.get('/api/history');return response.data;};export const getAnalysis=async id=>{console.log("[DEBUG client.js] Fetching analysis #".concat(id," from ").concat(API_BASE_URL,"/api/history/").concat(id,"..."));const response=await api.get("/api/history/".concat(id));return response.data;};
